caption: A small magnet is pressed against a refrigerator door and released, and it stays stuck on the door.

sa.check: A small magnet is pressed against it.
The magnet is released: the hand or tool withdraws.
The magnet stays on the door.
The magnet is small, fridge-magnet sized.
The order is press, release, stays.

pc.expect: After release the magnet holds where it was placed on the vertical door, with nothing supporting it.
pc.fail: The magnet drops when the hand lets go; or slides slowly down the door; or floats away from the door; or hangs a gap away from the surface without touching.

pc.expect: Once released the magnet stays put: it does not slide, rotate or creep.
pc.fail: The magnet moves across the door after release with nothing touching it; or rotates; or jumps to a new spot.

pc.expect: An item tucked under the magnet stays too, held against the door.
pc.fail: The item falls while the magnet stays; or the item floats up; or the item is held while the magnet is off the door.
pc.precondition: A photo, note or other item is tucked under the magnet.

pc.expect: The magnet stays a rigid solid and the door does not dent.
pc.fail: The magnet squashes like putty against the door; or the door surface deforms around it; or the magnet bounces off and then sticks.

pc.expect: One magnet on the outside of the door; the door and hand keep their shape.
pc.fail: The magnet sinks into the door; or a second magnet appears; or the magnet vanishes; or fingers pass through the magnet.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The magnet's colour and design and the other items on the door stay the same.
pc.fail: The magnet changes colour or shape; or other magnets or notes on the door move or vanish; or the door changes colour.
